meta.title: JanSathi: government schemes in your language
meta.description: Find government schemes you may qualify for, in your language. Every answer links to an official source.
hero.display_label: JanSathi: find government schemes you may qualify for
hero.lead: Government schemes, explained simply in your language. Every answer links to an official source.
hero.cta_primary: Check what I may qualify for
preview.banner: Preview: these schemes are drafts. We checked them against official sources, but a human reviewer has not yet verified them. Check with the office before you apply.
rail.title: Schemes we are checking
tiles.title: Find help for
how.title: Clear rules, official sources, your language
how.step1.title: Answer a few questions
how.step1.body: Tap, type or speak. Skip anything you are not sure about.
how.step2.title: Rules check the schemes
how.step2.body: Each scheme's written rules are checked against your answers. No guessing, and no AI deciding for you.
how.step3.title: See why
how.step3.body: For every scheme you see which rule fits, which does not, and what we still need to know.
how.step4.title: Check the source
how.step4.body: Every fact links to the official government page or document, with the date it was checked.
q.no_match: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please tap an answer.
q.exact_why: A scheme's limit falls inside the range you chose, so an exact number helps.
q.done_title: That's all we need for now
q.done_body: You can see your results, or change any answer later.
q.privacy_note: Your answers stay on this phone. We never ask for Aadhaar or bank account numbers.
q.exact.age: What is your exact age in years?
q.annual_income: What is your family's total income in a year?
q.exact.annual_income: What is your family's exact yearly income, in rupees?
q.social_category: Which social category do you belong to?
q.is_bpl: Does your family have a BPL or Antyodaya ration card?
q.disability_percent: What percentage of disability is on your certificate?
q.exact.disability_percent: What exact percentage is on your disability certificate?
q.is_pregnant_or_lactating: Are you pregnant, or breastfeeding a baby?
q.owns_farmland: Does your family own farm land in its own name?
q.family_pays_income_tax: Did anyone in your family pay income tax last year?
q.family_has_govt_job: Does anyone in your family have, or retire from, a government or PSU job above Group D, or get a pension of ₹10,000 or more a month?
help.family_has_govt_job: Group D, Class IV and Multi Tasking Staff jobs do not count. Family means husband, wife and children under 18.
q.family_has_registered_professional: Does anyone in your family work as a registered doctor, engineer, lawyer, chartered accountant or architect?
q.is_govt_employee: Do you have a regular job with the central or state government, or a PSU?
q.has_pucca_house: Does your family's house have a pucca roof or pucca walls, or more than two rooms?
q.in_pmjay_list: Is your family on the Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) list, or do you have an Ayushman card?
help.in_pmjay_list: You can check on the official beneficiary website or at a Common Service Centre.
q.has_daughter_under_10: Do you have a daughter younger than 10?
q.household_has_govt_employee: Does anyone in your family work for the government, at any level?
q.member_earns_over_15000: Does anyone in your family earn more than ₹15,000 a month?
q.household_has_vehicle_or_kcc: Does your family own a car, tractor or other motor vehicle with 3 or 4 wheels, or have a Kisan Credit Card with a limit of ₹50,000 or more?
q.owns_large_land: Does your family own 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land, or 5 acres or more of other land?
q.has_registered_business: Does your family run a non-farm business registered with the government, or pay professional tax?
q.has_eshram_card: Do you have an e-Shram card?
q.has_job_card: Does your family have a rural job card (MGNREGA job card or Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card)?
q.has_formal_pension_cover: Are you covered by EPF, ESIC or NPS, or do you get any other government pension?
q.personal_income_over_15000: Do you yourself earn more than ₹15,000 a month?
q.household_has_lpg: Does your household already have an LPG gas connection?
q.breadwinner_died_18_59: Has your household's main earner died while aged between 18 and 59?
help.breadwinner_died_18_59: The main earner is the person whose earnings support the household most. A woman who runs the home also counts.
q.is_traditional_artisan: Do you work on your own, with your hands and tools, in a traditional trade such as carpenter, blacksmith, potter, cobbler, mason, barber, tailor, washerman, goldsmith, basket maker or fishing net maker?
q.had_govt_business_loan_5y: In the last 5 years, have you taken a government self-employment loan such as PMEGP, or a Mudra or PM SVANidhi loan that is not yet fully repaid?
q.is_street_vendor: Do you sell goods or food on the street, from a cart, stall or basket?
q.has_residential_electricity: Does your household have its own home electricity connection?
q.has_nfsa_ration_card: Does your family have a ration card under the National Food Security Act (Antyodaya or Priority Household)?
q.land_up_to_2_ha: Does your family own 2 hectares (about 5 acres) or less of farm land?
result.title: Schemes for you

result.empty: Answer a few questions to see which schemes may fit you.
result.need_info: We need a bit more information
result.not_eligible: This scheme may not fit you
result.check_office: We are not sure about this rule. Check it with the office.
result.summary_read: {likely} schemes may fit you. {need} need more information.
trust.stale_warning: This information may be out of date. Check with the office before you apply.
trust.draft_warning: Draft: we checked this scheme against its official sources, but a human reviewer has not yet verified it.
detail.add_checklist: Add these documents to my checklist
detail.in_english: This scheme's text is not yet available in your language, so it is shown in English.
detail.not_found: I couldn't find an official source for this.
source.not_verified: Not yet verified by a reviewer
checklist.title: My document checklist
checklist.lead: Documents for the schemes you added. Mark each one you already have.
checklist.empty: Your checklist is empty. Open a scheme and add its documents.
schemes.title: All schemes
schemes.lead: Central government schemes in JanSathi so far. Open one to see its rules, documents and official sources.
search.title: Search schemes

search.none: I couldn't find an official source for this.

ask.unsupported: Voice input is not available in this browser. You can type instead.
ask.denied: The microphone is blocked. You can allow it in your browser settings, or type instead.
speech.no_voice: This device has no voice for {language}. You can still read the text.
speech.unsupported: Reading aloud is not available in this browser.
help.title: Nearby help
privacy.title: Your data
privacy.body1: Your answers and checklist are saved only on this device. They are not sent to us.
privacy.body2: We never ask for Aadhaar numbers or bank account numbers.
privacy.body3: You can delete everything at any time.
privacy.confirm: Delete your answers and checklist from this device?
privacy.deleted: Your data has been deleted from this device.
footer.disclaimer: JanSathi is not a government service. Final decisions are made by the government.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offline: You are offline. Showing saved information.

q.state: Which state or union territory do you live in?
q.is_registered_construction_worker: Are you registered with your state's construction workers' welfare board (labour card)?
q.last_exam_percent: What percentage did you get in your last exam?
q.exact.last_exam_percent: What exact percentage did you get?
q.is_minority: Do you belong to a notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain or Parsi)?
help.is_minority: Some scholarships are only for these communities. You can skip this question.
trust.ai_checked_long: Two independent AI reviewers compared this scheme with its official sources on {date}. A person has not checked it yet. Check with the office before you apply.
changes.title: What changed recently
changes.lead: Official updates to schemes, in plain words. Each one links to its source.
family.title: My family
family.lead: Add the people in your household. Questions about the household are asked once; each person answers their own questions.
slip.title: Take this to the office
slip.lead: The schemes you chose and the documents to carry. It has no personal details.
slip.footer: Made with JanSathi. JanSathi is not a government service; the government decides.
checklist.ready_long: You have all the required documents for {scheme}.
state.pick_first: Choose your state to see its schemes too.
marquee.label: Languages JanSathi speaks
manifesto.line3: explained in your language and read aloud.
stats.title: Built on official sources, not guesswork
stats.rules: eligibility rules, each tied to a clause
stats.verified_note: These counts come from the data in this app. Schemes verified by a human reviewer so far: {n}.
trust.title: Written rules decide. Every fact shows its source.
trust.confirmed_body: The rule comes from a gazette notification or the official guidelines.
trust.guidance_body: The rule comes from an official website, FAQ or government statement. Check the details with the office.
trust.unverified_body: A reviewer has not checked this yet, or the source may have changed. We always show a warning.
cta.title: Find out in a few minutes
cta.body: Answer a few simple questions by tapping or speaking. Skip anything you are not sure about. Your answers stay on this phone.
theme.label: Colour theme
ask.sources_note: These are rules from official sources that match your question. They are not a decision: check with the office.
report.sent: Thank you. A reviewer will check this scheme against its official sources.
ask.answer_note: This explanation was written by AI from the official rules below, with their sources. It is not a decision: check with the office.
auth.title: Sign in with your mobile number
auth.lead: Sign in to talk to Saathi, keep your answers on any phone, and get help from a helper.
auth.dev_code: Test mode: no SMS is sent. Your code is {code}.
auth.privacy: We keep only the last 4 digits of your number. Never share your Aadhaar or bank account number with anyone in this app.
auth.unavailable: Signing in needs the JanSathi server, which is not connected right now. You can still use the questions and the checklist.
auth.too_many: Too many codes for this number. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
auth.wrong_code: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check the SMS or ask for a new code.
guide.title: Saathi, your guide
guide.lead: Ask in your own words, or tap an answer. Saathi asks the questions, explains which schemes may fit and why, and shows where each fact comes from. The written rules decide, and the government makes the final decision.
guide.ai_note: Saathi is an AI. It can make mistakes, so every scheme fact links to its official source.
guide.sign_in: Sign in to talk to Saathi
guide.question: Question
guide.help_requested: A helper has been asked to look at your answers. On your account page you can see who looked, and stop it any time.
guide.no_model: The AI part of Saathi is not switched on yet. You can still answer the questions below by tapping.
guide.no_model_helper: The AI assistant is not switched on yet. The answers and results above come from the rules.
guide.unavailable: Saathi could not answer just now. Try again, or answer the question below.
guide.unsafe: Saathi’s answer did not pass our safety check, so it is not shown. Please ask again in other words.
guide.slow_down: Too many messages. Wait a few minutes and try again.
guide.forget_confirm: Delete your conversation with Saathi? Your answers stay saved.
account.title: My account
account.delete_confirm: Delete your account, answers, conversation and sharing from JanSathi? This cannot be undone.
share.title: Get help from a helper
share.lead: A helper from an NGO or a Common Service Centre can look at your answers and guide you. You choose what they see, and you can stop it any time.
share.create: Make a code for my helper
share.asked: Your request is in the queue. A helper will pick it up.
share.code_title: Read this code to your helper
notes.title: Messages from your helper
audit.title: Who looked at your information
helper.title: Helper portal
helper.lead: Help people with their scheme questions. You see only what a person shares with you, only while they allow it, and they can see every time you look.
helper.not_helper: This page is for registered helpers. Ask your organisation to register your mobile number.
helper.code_not_found: No active case has this code. Check the code with the person.
helper.requests_empty: No one is waiting right now.
helper.case_ended: This case has ended, or the person stopped sharing it.
helper.note_placeholder: Write a short, clear next step. Never ask for Aadhaar or bank numbers.
helper.assistant_placeholder: For example: which documents are still missing?
apps.title: My applications
apps.reason_hint: For example: the income certificate was old. Do not write Aadhaar or bank numbers.
apps.note: This is your own note. JanSathi is not connected to government systems, so check the real status with the office.
apps.empty: Nothing to track yet. Add a scheme to your checklist first.
window.title: When to apply
window.rolling: No fixed last date is recorded. Check the official site before you apply.
window.seasonal: Applications open by season, and the dates differ by state. Check the official site for your last date.
window.yearly: Applications open once a year. The dates are not recorded here yet, so check the official site.
window.unknown: The dates are not recorded here yet, so check the official site.
relation.title: Schemes to look at together
relation.excludes: You can usually get only one of this scheme and {scheme}.
relation.stacks_with: This scheme can usually be combined with {scheme}.
relation.pair_excludes: You can usually get only one of {a} and {b}.
remind.label: Remind me about unfinished documents and last dates
remind.note: About once a week. You can switch this off any time.
remind.enabled_in_app: Reminders are on. You will see them when you open JanSathi.
remind.deadline: A last date is close: {date}. Open your checklist.
remind.documents: Documents still missing from your checklist: {n}.
remind.push_body: Your checklist is not finished yet. Open it to see what is left.
ocr.button: Check a photo of this document
ocr.privacy: The photo is read on this phone. It is not saved or sent anywhere.
ocr.working: Reading the photo. The first time can take a minute.
ocr.looks_right: The photo is readable and looks like the right kind of document.
ocr.cannot_tell: The photo is readable, but we could not tell what kind of document it is.
ocr.not_readable: The photo is hard to read. Try again in good light, with the whole page in view.
ocr.too_large: This file is too large. Try a smaller photo.
ocr.failed: The photo could not be checked. You can still mark the document yourself.
ocr.not_proof: This does not show that the document is valid. Only the office can decide that.
nearby.lead: Find Common Service Centres, government offices and post offices near you. You can also ask at your gram panchayat or block office.
nearby.privacy: Your location is used only when you tap the button. It is rounded to about 1 km and sent to OpenStreetMap to find places. JanSathi does not save it.
nearby.denied: We could not get your location. Use the official CSC locator, or ask at your gram panchayat.
nearby.failed: The map service did not answer. Try again, or use the official CSC locator.
nearby.none: No places were found on the map near you. Use the official CSC locator.
nearby.caveat: These places come from OpenStreetMap, a map made by volunteers. This is not an official list, so check before you travel.
share.scope_sensitive: My category, disability and income answers
share.conversation_note: If you share your conversation, it is only shown when you also share your category, disability and income answers, because you may have mentioned them.
share.checklist_note: Your document list can show your category or disability (for example a caste or disability certificate).
q.has_young_daughter: Is there a girl in your family who is a newborn or still in school?
q.family_has_up_to_two_children: Does your family have two children or fewer?
q.family_marriage_planned: Is a daughter's wedding, or your own wedding or remarriage, coming up?
q.wants_to_start_business: Do you want to start a new business of your own?
q.runs_small_business: Do you already run a small business that is not farming?
q.in_odop_trade: Do you make, or plan to make, your district's One District One Product (ODOP) item?
q.works_in_skilled_trade: Do you work in a trade such as tailor, carpenter, potter, barber, mason, plumber, or mobile or electrical repair?
q.got_toolkit_2y: Have you received a toolkit from any scheme in the last two years?
q.has_child_under_18: Do you have a child under 18 in your family?
q.top_20_percent_class_12: Were you in the top 20% of those who passed class 12 in your stream and board?
q.preparing_for_competitive_exam: Are you preparing for an exam such as UPSC, state civil services, NDA, JEE or NEET?
q.gets_govt_pension: Do you already get a pension from a state or central government scheme?
q.got_aid_last_3y: In the last 3 years, have you had help from any source for the same aid or appliance?
admin.title: Review desk
admin.lead: For JanSathi staff. Your own account, a password and a code from your authenticator app.
admin.unavailable: The review desk needs the JanSathi server.
admin.sign_in_failed: These details are not right, or the account is locked for a while.
admin.bootstrap_note: Only to create the first staff accounts. Remove the token from the server afterwards.
admin.setup_secret: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
admin.setup_done: Your account is ready. You can sign in now.
admin.setup_issued: Set-up code for {username}. It is shown once and lasts 48 hours:
admin.deactivate_too: Also deactivate this helper and end their cases
admin.helpers_note: A helper who is idle for 90 days is deactivated automatically.
admin.publish_note: This page only shows status. Scheme content is published with tools/publish.mjs, after two independent reviews of the exact content.
detail.machine_translated: This text was translated by a machine. A person has not checked the translation.
nearby.pin_none: India Post has no record of this PIN code. Check it and try again.
apps.share_note: This helps others avoid the same problem. Only the scheme, the result and the reason are sent. Your name and number are not.
outcomes.title: Common reasons for rejection
outcomes.note: Shared anonymously by {n} people. This is their experience, not a scheme rule.
remind.phone_note: Enter the number you signed in with. It is kept encrypted, and only while this is on.
remind.channel_failed: This could not be turned on. Try again later.
account.on_device_only: This account is for someone under 18, so everything stays on this phone. Sharing, reminders and Saathi are off.
grievance.title: Raise a complaint
grievance.lead: Tell us if something went wrong with your data, a helper or the information here. You do not need to sign in.
grievance.sent: Your complaint was received. Its reference is:
grievance.keep_id: Keep this reference to ask about your complaint.
grievance.no_numbers: Do not write Aadhaar or bank numbers.
grievance.failed: It could not be sent. Try again.
grievance.unavailable: Complaints need the JanSathi server, which is not connected right now.
helper_report.title: Report a helper
helper_report.lead: Help through JanSathi is free. Tell us if a helper asked for money or misused your information.
helper_report.sent: Your report was sent. It will be checked.
helper_report.failed: It could not be sent. Try again.
helper_report.reason_pretended_to_be_off: Pretended to be a government officer
reminder.checklist: JanSathi: your checklist still has documents to collect. Open the app to see them.
reminder.deadline: JanSathi: a scheme on your checklist has a last date of {date} on its official source. Open the app to check it.
reminder.telegram_linked: JanSathi reminders are on. Send /stop any time to end them.
reminder.telegram_stopped: JanSathi reminders are off, and this chat is no longer linked.
reminder.telegram_link_failed: This link has expired or was already used. Make a new one in the JanSathi app.
reminder.telegram_help: To get reminders, open JanSathi, sign in and choose Telegram.
q.has_artisan_card: Do you have a handicraft artisan card from the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts)?
q.at_top_class_institute: Do you study at an institute on the government's Top Class list for students with disabilities?
